description: Entirely fictional financial corpus; no customer information.

evidence.text: Fictional account ALPHA opened January 2025 with EUR 1000.00.
During January 2025, cash receipts were EUR 600.00 and cash payments were EUR 250.00.
The closing balance on 31 January 2025 was EUR 1350.00.
January 2025 cash expenses were office supplies EUR 100.00 and utilities EUR 150.00, totaling EUR 250.00.
The EUR 250.00 total includes no refunds and no internal transfers.
January 2025 recognized revenue was EUR 800.00, including EUR 200.00 not yet collected.
January 2025 customer cash receipts were EUR 600.00.
Recognized revenue and cash receipts are different measures; unpaid invoices can explain the difference.
February 2025 planned expenses are EUR 300.00. This is a plan, not an actual expense.
An unresolved draft dated 20 January 2025 proposes February expenses of EUR 350.00. Neither figure is designated authoritative.
A separate fictional USD account has a January 2025 closing balance of USD 90.00. No exchange rate is provided.
User B's fictional March 2025 planning reserve is EUR 700.00.
